anchors.claim: Most people exposed to loss or trauma recover naturally without intervention
anchors.detail: Longitudinal study following 9/11 survivors showed majority returned to baseline functioning within 18 months
anchors.quote: The most common response to loss is not prolonged grief or dysfunction but resilience

anchors.quote: The view you adopt for yourself profoundly affects the way you lead your life

anchors.claim: Finding meaning in suffering is a path to psychological resilience
anchors.detail: Viktor Frankl's experiences in concentration camps led to logotherapy
